planning_notes: No Serial I/O requirements were provided; therefore no serial_channels are defined.
Control period chosen as 10 ms as scheduling granularity; sensor sampling period and acquisition-to-display latency enforcement are handled in SysML using elapsed_ms.
Per requirement, TRIG=D8, ECHO=D9, TM1637 CLK=D4, DIO=D5 are preserved.
Ultrasonic timeout must be 25000us for each measurement attempt; exact timeout_us is configured as 25000 to satisfy the constraint.

Distance-to-display quantization (integer cm, 1cm tolerance) and blanking on timeout/out-of-range are handled in the model; hardware ports only provide raw distance and validity plus the TM1637 number request.

TM1637 initial blank: tm1637_number startup uses out-of-display-range initial command 10000 so the catalog can blank at startup; model later outputs either integer cm or blank via the same tm1637_number command.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Distance measurement in cm; derived from echo microseconds / 58

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Validity flag for ultrasonic distance (true when echo within 2..400cm and not timed out)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: TM1637 distance display request; 10000 requests startup blank (quantized integer cm shown by model)

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
使用 TM1637 + HC-SR04（D8/D9）：显示距离
验收约定：目标板Uno；HC-SR04 TRIG=D8、ECHO=D9，TM1637 CLK=D4、DIO=D5。距离以cm为单位，回波微秒数除58；有效范围2..400cm，显示整数厘米（量化容差1cm，前导零或空白均可）。采样开始间隔60..160ms，变化250ms内反映（包含测量等待和显示传输）。每次等待回波必须有25000us超时；无回波、卡高或越界时显示空白，恢复后继续显示真实距离。初始显示空白；测量值和有效性必须区分，不得将超时当成0cm。原需求未指定的CLK/DIO采用上述公开接线，各组相同。
